edits.old: Then no case appears on both pages
edits.new:
Then no case appears on both pages

  Scenario: AC12 A caller without a valid session or without Case record R is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    When the caller requests the list without a valid session or with a role that does not hold Case record R
    Then the response is 403 with message MSG-P4-002 or 401 with message MSG-P4-001
    Then the system reads no case

  Scenario: AC13 A seed pack that cannot load stops the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the seed pack cannot be loaded or the evidence cannot be attached
    When the harness starts the run
    Then the run refuses to start and names the missing seed item, or is marked failed
    Then the local evidence file is kept for rerun
